name: Word Bomb
desc:
💣 Inspired by BombParty on JKLM!
👋 A major update to Word Bomb is coming soon. Enable notifications and follow the group for more details.

📚 COMMANDS
To see a list of all commands, visit this link:
https://devforum.roblox.com/t/commands/3025377

🙂 Please do not be mad at others for helping people or using Google, learning is encouraged, and it is NOT cheating!

🎮 It's a pass-it-on bomb game! Type words containing specific letters to pass the bomb on to somebody else.
The bomb ticks faster and faster the longer a round goes on. The last man standing wins!

👍 Good for learning new words, quick typing skills, reaction time, and for obtaining very high IQ.
